The throwing guard is `assertCan()` in `src/lib/permissions.ts:150`. It calls `explain()` and, when the check fails, throws `PermissionDeniedError` instead of returning a boolean. `can()` is the version that returns a boolean.

I searched for every reference to `assertCan`, including namespace imports. It is only called from the 14 service files in `src/server/services/`, which matches the layering rule in `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts` that services are the only layer allowed to call it. The actions, pages, components and hooks all use `can()`.

- **Left out: tests.** `tests/contract/permissions.test.ts` and `tests/lib/permissions.ownership.test.ts` also call it, but they are tests, not source files.
- **Left out: comment-only mentions.** `src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts`, `src/components/domain/permission/permission-gate.tsx` and `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx` only name it in comments, and `src/server/services/_support.ts` only mentions `@/lib/permissions` in a comment. None of them call it.

ANSWER: src/server/services/label-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts
